stories.title: 贵州省政协原副秘书长、办公厅原副主任王明亮被开除公职

en.title: Wang Mingliang, former deputy secretary-general of Guizhou Provincial Political Consultative Conference, dismissed from public office
en.summary: Wang Mingliang, who previously served as deputy secretary-general of the Guizhou Provincial Political Consultative Conference and deputy director of its office, has been removed from public office following an investigation into serious violations of law approved by provincial authorities.

stories.title: 两部门联合印发《民航数据治理体系建设实施方案》

en.title: Two departments jointly issue implementation plan for civil aviation data governance system construction
en.summary: The Civil Aviation Administration and the National Data Bureau have jointly released an implementation plan for establishing a civil aviation data governance system.

stories.title: 国台办回应台湾艺人政治表态问题

en.title: Taiwan Affairs Office responds to Taiwan artist's political statement issue
en.summary: The State Council Taiwan Affairs Office addressed a situation involving a Taiwan band member at an Apple event where staff discouraged discussion of the artist's origin, sparking debate about whether Taiwan artists should make political statements at international activities.

stories.title: 贵州省人大教育科学文化卫生委员会原副主任委员孔德明被开除党籍

en.title: Kong Deming, former deputy chairman of Guizhou Provincial People's Congress Education, Science, Culture and Health Committee, expelled from party
en.summary: Kong Deming, previously a deputy chairman of the Guizhou Provincial People's Congress Education, Science, Culture and Health Committee, has been expelled from the party following an investigation into serious disciplinary and legal violations.

stories.title: ‘Red line’: Saudi coalition accuses Houthis of targeting Mecca with drone

en.title: 'Red line': Saudi coalition accuses Houthis of targeting Mecca with drone
en.summary: The Saudi-led coalition alleged that Yemen's Houthis attempted to strike Mecca with a drone, triggering widespread Muslim outrage. The Iran-backed Houthis have intensified regional conflict through maritime attacks and a blockade against Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: 司法部：加快推进首个全国性涉外法律服务平台正式上线运行

en.title: Ministry of Justice: Accelerating the official launch and operation of China's first national foreign-related legal service platform
en.summary: China's Ministry of Justice announced efforts to expedite the launch of the country's inaugural nationwide legal services platform for foreign-related matters. The announcement was made during a briefing on implementing rule of law initiatives during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.

stories.title: 国台办回应中国台北参与APEC

en.title: Taiwan Affairs Office responds to Chinese Taipei's participation in APEC
en.summary: China's Taiwan Affairs Office commented on the use of the name "Chinese Taipei" by Taiwan representatives at APEC events. Taiwan's labor minister confirmed that "Chinese Taipei" is Taiwan's official designation within APEC.

stories.title: 司法部：将持续纠治涉企乱执法、滥执法

en.title: Ministry of Justice: Will continue to rectify arbitrary and abusive law enforcement against enterprises
en.summary: China's Ministry of Justice pledged to continue addressing unlawful enforcement actions affecting businesses. Officials discussed dispute resolution, legal governance, business environment improvement, and commercial mediation during a briefing on 15th Five-Year Plan implementation.

stories.title: Chinese scientists build world’s smallest CT scanner, weighing just 6kg

en.title: Chinese scientists build world's smallest CT scanner, weighing just 6kg
en.summary: Chinese researchers have developed a portable CT scanner weighing 6 kilograms, designed for imaging small fossils and archaeological artifacts. The device, called the Xtomo-Cube, is small enough to fit in one hand.

stories.title: 司法部：将持续纠治乱执法、滥执法，进一步防止随意干扰企业正常生产经营

en.title: Justice Ministry: Will continue to rectify arbitrary and abusive enforcement, further prevent random interference with normal business operations
en.summary: Chinese authorities have investigated over 90,000 cases of problematic business-related enforcement actions and recovered nearly 31 billion yuan in economic losses for enterprises. Administrative inspection frequency has declined significantly while accuracy and effectiveness have improved.

stories.title: Chinese VP addresses welcome banquet of Beijing Xiangshan Forum

en.title: Chinese VP addresses welcome banquet of Beijing Xiangshan Forum
en.summary: Chinese Vice President Han Zheng addressed the welcome banquet of the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum, attended by official representatives from nearly 100 countries, regions, and international organizations.

stories.title: US-China ties haunted by lack of mutual trust, Beijing Xiangshan Forum told

en.title: US-China ties haunted by lack of mutual trust, Beijing Xiangshan Forum told
en.summary: Speakers at a major Beijing security conference highlighted the absence of mutual trust in US-China relations, noting persistent significant problems despite existing agreements on strategic stability.

stories.title: GSK licenses Chinese firm’s cancer drug in US$750 million deal

en.title: GSK licenses Chinese firm's cancer drug in US$750 million deal
en.summary: British pharmaceutical company GSK agreed to acquire global rights to a cancer drug developed by Chinese firm Chimagen Biosciences for up to US$750 million, highlighting China's growing role in biotechnology innovation.

stories.title: Southeast Asian buyers emerge as top non-local investors in Hong Kong commercial property

en.title: Southeast Asian buyers emerge as top non-local investors in Hong Kong commercial property
en.summary: Southeast Asian investors, particularly from Singapore, have become the largest group of non-local buyers in Hong Kong's commercial property market, accounting for a significant portion of major transactions this year.

stories.title: Hong Kong commercial property downturn to worsen amid tightening credit: agents

en.title: Hong Kong commercial property downturn to worsen amid tightening credit: agents
en.summary: Hong Kong's commercial property market faces continued decline as banks tighten lending standards, potentially creating a vicious cycle of reduced credit availability and weakening demand.

stories.title: Tighter scrutiny of Hong Kong IPOs could slow deal flow, analysts say

en.title: Tighter scrutiny of Hong Kong IPOs could slow deal flow, analysts say
en.summary: Hong Kong and mainland Chinese regulators are intensifying quality standards for IPOs, which may reduce the pace of new listings. Analysts indicate this will not diminish underlying demand for listings.

stories.title: Wrise Prestige accelerates mainland China expansion with new offices, AI lab

en.title: Wrise Prestige accelerates mainland China expansion with new offices, AI lab
en.summary: Singapore-based wealth manager Wrise Prestige is expanding in mainland China and investing heavily in artificial intelligence, including opening an AI laboratory in Guangzhou and allocating HK$30 million to AI development.
